BiblicalUsage: The Chaldeans answer Nebuchadnezzar a second time. When the king demands the dream itself, they answer again and say, let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the small word carries the standoff of the whole chapter: the king will not tell, the wise men cannot guess, and the second answer only deepens the deadlock that Daniel must break.
